slots.name: silicosis cases
slots.sentence: The California Department of Public Health estimated in an Oct. 7 report that 662 silicosis cases, including 35 deaths and 75 cases resulting in lung transplants, have been diagnosed among quartz manufacturers and workers in the state since 2019.
